_comment: All human-facing comment copy. Edit wording here — comment.mjs only selects and fills {{PLACEHOLDER}}s, it holds no prose. RV=reported version, AL/BL=leg labels (vX / trunk), AS/BS=leg statuses.

live_bug.headline: Bug reproduced — present on the reported version and on trunk
live_bug.summary: Reproduced the reported bug on **v{{RV}}** and on **trunk** ({{DATE}}) via {{SURFACE}} with {{EXECUTOR}}.

fixed_on_trunk.headline: Bug reproduced on the reported version — already fixed on trunk
fixed_on_trunk.summary: Reproduced on **v{{RV}}** but NOT on **trunk** ({{DATE}}) via {{SURFACE}} — it appears fixed on trunk.{{FIX_SUFFIX}}

regression.headline: Regression — fine on the reported version, broken on trunk
regression.summary: NOT reproduced on **v{{RV}}** but reproduced on **trunk** ({{DATE}}) via {{SURFACE}} — this looks like a regression introduced after v{{RV}}.
regression.callout: > ⚠️ Confirm the reported leg actually exercised the symptom — a missing fixture can fake a regression.

not_reproducible.headline: Could not reproduce the bug
not_reproducible.summary: Could not reproduce on **v{{RV}}** or **trunk** ({{DATE}}) via {{SURFACE}} — the generated repro may not faithfully exercise the reported scenario.
not_reproducible.callout: > ℹ️ The symptom was observed on NEITHER version, including the reported (buggy) one — most often the repro doesn't faithfully hit the scenario. Confirm before closing.

needs_human_review.headline: {{NHR_HEADLINE}}
needs_human_review.summary: {{NHR_UNDERLYING}} — **but the automated verdict is not trusted**{{UNSURE_SUFFIX}}. {{NHR_TAIL}}

blocked.headline: Reproduction blocked (environment)
blocked.summary: The reproduction environment did not come up, so nothing was run.

phrases.nhr_headline_with_fix: Reported precondition not found — needs human review
phrases.nhr_tail_with_fix: Candidate fix to inspect: {{FIX}}. Confirm that this PR/commit removed the reported precondition before closing.
phrases.nhr_tail: The evidence below is informative; confirm the repro faithfully matches the report before acting.
phrases.nhr_callout_with_fix: > 🟡 Treat as inconclusive — inspect {{FIX}} as a possible fix candidate for the missing reported state.
phrases.nhr_callout: > 🟡 Treat as unconfirmed — a human should verify the repro faithfully matches the report before acting.

nhr_underlying.reproduced/reproduced: Both **{{AL}}** and **{{BL}}** reproduced the symptom (alone that would read as a live bug)
nhr_underlying.reproduced/not_reproduced: **{{AL}}** reproduced the symptom but **{{BL}}** did not (alone that would read as fixed on trunk)
nhr_underlying.not_reproduced/reproduced: **{{BL}}** reproduced the symptom but **{{AL}}** did not (alone that would read as a regression)

gloss.reproduced: → the healthy assertion **failed**, so the symptom is present — **bug reproduced**.
gloss.not_reproduced: → the healthy assertion **passed** — no symptom on this version (**healthy**).
gloss.inconclusive: → the symptom **could not be judged** here — needs a human look.
gloss.blocked: → the environment/seed **failed** — this leg did not run.

incomplete_reason_default: The agent did not produce a verified reproduction bundle.
